evidence.quote: The primary mission of ZYZZsat is to image the whole Great Barrier Reef in visible bands at 5 m resolution
The operator is the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS)

criteria.reasoning: Mission need, direct-detection rationale, single-spacecraft choice, operator and customers are all clearly explained with appropriate references. Strong introduction.

evidence.quote: The most suitable orbit is a low-Earth sun-synchronous orbit
There are six passes each day, three in the evening and three in the morning (UTC)

criteria.reasoning: Launch, orbit elements, coverage, communications, manoeuvres, duration and EOL are comprehensively addressed with STK screenshots, tables and hand calculations. Minor weaknesses in revisit estimate and link budget do not prevent Accomplished.

evidence.quote: ZYZZsat meets the mission needs set out in the introduction with one 50 kg satellite.

criteria.reasoning: Conclusion summarises specific achieved performance and candidly identifies limitations and next steps. Detailed and evidence-based.

evidence.quote: This report presents the design of ZYZZsat
The following STK 11 files are submitted with this report in ZYZZsat_STK.zip.

criteria.reasoning: Clear engineering-report structure, concise writing, labelled figures/tables and matching citations. Some bibliography entries are incomplete or weakly formatted, so not top of range.

technical_issues.issue: Revisit-time calculation is a simple division of track spacing by roll-access width and is not demonstrated with an STK coverage/revisit analysis; it may be conservative or ambiguous.
No X-band link budget is presented; the 50 Mbit/s downlink and 34 min usable contact give an unverified 3.5 data margin.
Baseline Vega C was unflown at the report date, and rideshare injection dispersion cannot be corrected without propulsion; the delivered orbit may differ from 600 km and 97.79°.
Mount Pleasant is a radio astronomy/geodesy site; adding S-band and X-band capability is assumed without supporting evidence.

overall: Strong, concise report meeting all mission-design requirements. STK and hand calculations support launch, orbit, coverage, downlink and EOL. Minor weaknesses are the approximate revisit/roll calculation, missing X-band link budget, unflown Vega C baseline and assumed ground-station capability; these are acknowledged or limited in impact.
